Atlas Longevity

Privacy Policy

At Atlas Longevity, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us when you visit our website, contact us, submit an enquiry, create an account, or use any of our online services.

This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, how we protect it, and what rights you may have regarding your personal information.

 

1. Information We Collect

We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us, including:

  • Name
  • Phone number
  • WhatsApp number
  • Billing or shipping address
  • Company or organisation name
  • Enquiry details
  • Account registration information
  • Order or transaction-related information
  • Any other information you submit through forms, WhatsApp, phone, live chat, or other communication channels

We may also collect limited technical information automatically when you use our website, including:

  • IP address
  • Browser type
  • Device type
  • Pages visited
  • Time spent on the website
  • Referral source
  • Cookies and similar tracking data

2. How We Use Your Information

We may use your information to:

  • Respond to enquiries
  • Process requests, orders, or communications
  • Provide customer support
  • Improve our website and services
  • Verify user information where required
  • Maintain website security
  • Prevent misuse, fraud, or unauthorised activity
  • Comply with applicable legal, regulatory, or compliance obligations
  • Send service-related updates where necessary

We do not use your personal information to provide medical advice, treatment advice, dosage instructions, or any guidance related to human or animal use of research materials.

 

3. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve functionality, analyse website traffic, remember user preferences, and support security.

You can disable cookies through your browser settings. However, some parts of the website may not work properly if cookies are disabled.

 

4. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell your personal information.

We may share your information only when necessary with:

  • Website hosting providers
  • Payment processors
  • Shipping or logistics providers
  • IT support providers
  • Analytics or security services
  • Legal, regulatory, or compliance authorities where required
  • Professional advisers, such as legal or accounting representatives

Any third-party service providers are expected to handle your information securely and only for the purpose of providing services to us.

 

5. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect personal information from unauthorised access, misuse, loss, alteration, or disclosure.

However, no website, server, or online transmission is completely secure. You use the website at your own risk and are responsible for keeping your account details, passwords, and devices secure.

 

6. Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, prevent misuse, and maintain business records.

 

7. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Request access to your personal information
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your information
  • Object to certain uses of your information
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
  • Request a copy of the information we hold about you

To make a privacy request, contact us at:

Phone / WhatsApp: +6282326300167

Email: hello@peptidesbali.online

We may need to verify your identity before processing your request.

 

8. International Users

If you access our website from outside the country where our business operates, your information may be transferred to and processed in another jurisdiction. By using our website, you acknowledge that privacy laws may differ from those in your location.

 

9. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, policies, or actions of third-party websites. You should review their policies before providing any personal information.

 

10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated “Last Updated” date.

 

11. Contact Us

For privacy-related questions, contact us at:

Atlas Longevity
Phone / WhatsApp: +6282326300167

Email: hello@peptidesbali.online
Website: peptidesbali.online
